                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>前端圈一年&nbsp;<strong>365</strong>&nbsp;天，天天出新框架，但真正能让你<strong>少写代码、少引依赖、少踩性能坑</strong>的，其实是浏览器爸爸早已偷偷内置的「<strong>原生外挂</strong>」。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">1. ResizeObserver</h2>
<p><code>ResizeObserver</code> 是一个浏览器原生的 JavaScript API，用于<strong>监听 DOM 元素尺寸的变化</strong>。它类似于 <code>MutationObserver</code>，但专门用于观察元素的大小（宽高）变化，而无需依赖 <code>window.resize</code> 事件（后者只对视口变化有效）。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">🧩 基本用法</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> resizeObserver = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">entries</span> =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> entries) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { width, height } = entry.<span class="hljs-property">contentRect</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`元素尺寸：<span class="hljs-subst">${width}</span> x <span class="hljs-subst">${height}</span>`</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.target 是被观察的 DOM 元素</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'目标元素:'</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>);
  }
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 开始观察某个元素</span>
resizeObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'#my-element'</span>));

<span class="hljs-comment">// 可选：观察多个元素</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// resizeObserver.observe(element1);</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// resizeObserver.observe(element2);</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">📦 entry.contentRect vs getBoundingClientRect()</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>entry.contentRect</code>：表示<strong>内容区域</strong>（不包括 padding、border、margin），类似于&nbsp;<code>getComputedStyle().width/height</code>&nbsp;的计算结果。</li>
<li>如果你需要包括 border 和 padding 的尺寸，可以结合&nbsp;<code>entry.target.getBoundingClientRect()</code>&nbsp;使用。</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">🛑 停止观察</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 停止观察某个元素</span>
resizeObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">unobserve</span>(element);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 停止观察所有元素并释放资源</span>
resizeObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>();
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>建议</strong>：在组件销毁（如 React 的 <code>useEffect</code> 清理函数、Vue 的 <code>onBeforeUnmount</code>）时调用 <code>disconnect()</code>，避免内存泄漏。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">✅ 使用场景</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>响应式组件</strong>：当容器尺寸变化时动态调整子元素（如图表、Canvas、视频）。</li>
<li><strong>自定义滚动条或布局</strong>：监听内容区域变化以更新 UI。</li>
<li><strong>替代&nbsp;<code>window.onresize</code></strong>：更精确地响应<strong>特定元素</strong>的尺寸变化，而非整个窗口。</li>
<li><strong>Web Components / 封装组件</strong>：内部自动适配父容器大小。</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">🌐 浏览器兼容性</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ Chrome 64+</li>
<li>✅ Firefox 69+</li>
<li>✅ Safari 13.1+</li>
<li>✅ Edge 79+</li>
<li>❌ IE 不支持（需 polyfill）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>兼容性已非常广泛，现代项目可放心使用。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">🛠️ Polyfill（如需支持旧浏览器）</h3>
<p>可通过 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">GitHub - juggle/resize-observer</a> 提供的 polyfill：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">npm install @juggle/resize-observer
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@juggle/resize-observer'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 如果原生不支持，则使用 polyfill</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ResizeObserver</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ResizeObserver</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">示例：React 中使用</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect, useRef } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> containerRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);

  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ResizeObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">entries</span> =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> entries) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'新宽度:'</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">contentRect</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>);
      }
    });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (containerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>) {
      observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(containerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>);
    }

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 清理</span>
    };
  }, []);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{containerRef}</span>&gt;</span>可变尺寸容器<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-8">2.IntersectionObserver</h2>
<p><code>IntersectionObserver</code> 是一个强大的浏览器原生 API，用于<strong>异步监听目标元素与祖先元素（或视口）的交叉（相交）状态变化</strong>。它常用于实现<strong>懒加载、无限滚动、曝光统计、动画触发</strong>等场景，性能远优于传统的 <code>scroll</code> 事件监听。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">🧩 基本用法</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries, observer</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  entries.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">entry</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.target：被观察的 DOM 元素</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.isIntersecting：是否与根（viewport 或 root）相交</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.intersectionRatio：相交区域占目标元素的比例（0 ~ 1）</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.intersectionRect：相交区域的矩形信息</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.boundingClientRect：目标元素相对于视口的位置</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// entry.rootBounds：根元素的边界（通常是视口）</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'元素进入视口:'</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>);
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 例如：加载图片、触发动画</span>
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'元素离开视口'</span>);
    }
  });
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 开始观察某个元素</span>
observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'#my-element'</span>));
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">⚙️ 配置选项（可选）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> options = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">root</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 默认为视口（viewport）；可设为某个祖先元素</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">rootMargin</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'0px'</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 类似 CSS margin，扩展或收缩根的边界（支持负值）</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">threshold</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 触发回调的相交比例阈值（0 ~ 1），可为数字或数组</span>
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(callback, options);
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-11"><code>threshold</code>&nbsp;示例：</h4>
<ul>
<li><code>threshold: 0</code>：只要有一点进入就触发（默认）。</li>
<li><code>threshold: 1</code>：完全进入才触发。</li>
<li><code>threshold: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]</code>：在 0%、25%、50%... 时都触发。</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">🛑 停止观察</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">javascript
编辑
observer<span class="hljs-selector-class">.unobserve</span>(element); <span class="hljs-comment">// 停止单个元素</span>
observer<span class="hljs-selector-class">.disconnect</span>();      <span class="hljs-comment">// 停止所有并释放资源</span>
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>建议</strong>：在组件销毁时调用 <code>disconnect()</code>，防止内存泄漏。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">✅ 典型应用场景</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-14">1.&nbsp;<strong>图片懒加载</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imgObserver = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">IntersectionObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entries</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  entries.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">entry</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">isIntersecting</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = entry.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>;
      img.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = img.<span class="hljs-property">dataset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">src</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 从 data-src 加载真实图片</span>
      imgObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">unobserve</span>(img); <span class="hljs-comment">// 加载后停止观察</span>
    }
  });
});

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelectorAll</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'img[data-src]'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">img</span> =&gt;</span> {
  imgObserver.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>(img);
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-15">2.&nbsp;<strong>滚动到底部自动加载（无限滚动）</strong></h4>
<p>观察一个“哨兵”元素（如分页加载提示），当它进入视口时触发加载。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-16">3.&nbsp;<strong>曝光埋点 / 广告可见性统计</strong></h4>
<p>当广告或内容区域进入视口一定比例时，上报“曝光”事件。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-17">4.&nbsp;<strong>滚动动画（如 AOS 效果）</strong></h4>
<p>元素进入视口时添加 CSS 动画类。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">🌐 浏览器兼容性</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ Chrome 51+</li>
<li>✅ Firefox 55+</li>
<li>✅ Safari 12.1+</li>
<li>✅ Edge 15+</li>
<li>❌ IE 不支持（需 polyfill）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>现代浏览器支持良好，移动端也广泛可用。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-19">🛠️ Polyfill（兼容旧浏览器）</h3>
<p>官方推荐 polyfill（由 W3C 团队维护）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">npm install intersection-observer
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在应用入口引入（自动填充 window.IntersectionObserver）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-string">'intersection-observer'</span>;
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：polyfill 会回退到 <code>scroll</code> + <code>getBoundingClientRect()</code>，性能较差，仅用于兼容。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-20">💡 与&nbsp;<code>ResizeObserver</code>&nbsp;/&nbsp;<code>MutationObserver</code>&nbsp;对比</h3>





















<table><thead><tr><th>API</th><th>用途</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>IntersectionObserver</code></td><td>监听元素是否进入/离开视口（或指定容器）</td></tr><tr><td><code>ResizeObserver</code></td><td>监听元素尺寸变化</td></tr><tr><td><code>MutationObserver</code></td><td>监听 DOM 结构或属性变化</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>三者互补，常结合使用。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-21">📌 小技巧</h3>
<ul>
<li>使用&nbsp;<code>rootMargin: '100px'</code>&nbsp;可以<strong>提前触发</strong>（在元素距离视口还有 100px 时就加载）。</li>
<li>在&nbsp;<code>&lt;img loading="lazy"&gt;</code>&nbsp;普及的今天，简单图片懒加载可直接用 HTML 属性，但复杂逻辑仍需&nbsp;<code>IntersectionObserver</code>。</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-22">3.Page Visibility</h2>
<p><code>Page Visibility API</code> 是一个浏览器原生 API，用于检测<strong>当前网页是否对用户可见</strong>（即是否处于前台标签页或被最小化/切换到后台）。它可以帮助开发者优化性能、节省资源，或实现特定业务逻辑（如暂停视频、停止轮询、统计停留时长等）。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-23">🧩 核心属性与事件</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-24">1.&nbsp;<code>document.visibilityState</code></h4>
<p>返回当前页面的可见性状态，可能值包括：</p>

























<table><thead><tr><th>值</th><th>含义</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>'visible'</code></td><td>页面可见（处于前台标签页）</td></tr><tr><td><code>'hidden'</code></td><td>页面不可见（切换到其他标签页、最小化窗口、锁屏等）</td></tr><tr><td><code>'prerender'</code></td><td>页面正在预渲染（已废弃，现代浏览器基本不用）</td></tr><tr><td><code>'unloaded'</code></td><td>页面即将卸载（极少使用）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>实际开发中主要关注 <code>'visible'</code> 和 <code>'hidden'</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-25">2.&nbsp;<code>document.hidden</code>（已废弃，建议用&nbsp;<code>visibilityState</code>）</h4>
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>：页面不可见</li>
<li><code>false</code>：页面可见</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ 虽仍可用，但 MDN 建议使用 <code>visibilityState</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 data-id="heading-26">3.&nbsp;<code>visibilitychange</code>&nbsp;事件</h4>
<p>当页面可见性状态改变时触发。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-27">✅ 基本用法示例</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleVisibilityChange</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibilityState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'visible'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'页面回到前台'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 恢复视频播放、重启定时器、刷新数据等</span>
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibilityState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'hidden'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'页面进入后台'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 暂停视频、停止轮询、保存状态等</span>
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 监听可见性变化</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, handleVisibilityChange);
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-28">🌟 典型应用场景</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-29">1.&nbsp;<strong>暂停/恢复媒体播放</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> video = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'video'</span>);

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>) {
    video.<span class="hljs-title function_">pause</span>();
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    video.<span class="hljs-title function_">play</span>();
  }
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-30">2.&nbsp;<strong>停止不必要的轮询或定时任务</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> intervalId;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">startPolling</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  intervalId = <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>(fetchData, <span class="hljs-number">5000</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stopPolling</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(intervalId);
}

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">stopPolling</span>();
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">startPolling</span>();
  }
});

<span class="hljs-title function_">startPolling</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始启动</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-31">3.&nbsp;<strong>用户停留时长统计</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> startTime = <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> totalVisibleTime = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>) {
    totalVisibleTime += <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() - startTime;
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    startTime = <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
  }
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 页面卸载时上报总可见时长</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'beforeunload'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  totalVisibleTime += <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() - startTime;
  <span class="hljs-title function_">sendToAnalytics</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">visibleTime</span>: totalVisibleTime });
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-32">4.&nbsp;<strong>节省资源（如 Canvas 动画、WebGL）</strong></h4>
<p>在页面不可见时暂停渲染循环，减少 CPU/GPU 消耗。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-33">🌐 浏览器兼容性</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ Chrome 13+</li>
<li>✅ Firefox 10+</li>
<li>✅ Safari 7+</li>
<li>✅ Edge 12+</li>
<li>✅ iOS Safari / Android Browser（现代版本）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>兼容性极佳，几乎所有现代浏览器都支持。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-34">⚠️ 注意事项</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>不保证精确性</strong>：在某些系统（如 macOS 快速切换）中，状态切换可能有微小延迟。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不是用户活跃度检测</strong>：页面可见 ≠ 用户正在看（用户可能切到其他应用但浏览器窗口仍在前台）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>与&nbsp;<code>blur</code>/<code>focus</code>&nbsp;事件的区别</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>window.onfocus</code>&nbsp;/&nbsp;<code>window.onblur</code>：监听<strong>窗口焦点</strong>（如切换到其他应用）。</li>
<li><code>visibilitychange</code>：监听<strong>标签页是否可见</strong>（即使窗口有焦点，但标签页在后台也算 hidden）。</li>
<li>两者可结合使用以获得更全面的状态判断。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-35">🔍 扩展：结合&nbsp;<code>focus</code>/<code>blur</code>&nbsp;更精准判断</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> isPageVisible = !<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> isWindowFocused = !<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">hasFocus</span>();

<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'focus'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  isWindowFocused = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isPageVisible) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'用户很可能正在看页面'</span>);
  }
});

<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'blur'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  isWindowFocused = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
});

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  isPageVisible = !<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>;
});
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-36">4.Web Share API</h2>
<p><code>Web Share API</code> 是一个现代浏览器提供的原生 API，允许网页<strong>调用操作系统级别的分享功能</strong>，让用户将内容（如链接、文本、标题等）快速分享到设备上安装的其他应用（如微信、邮件、短信、笔记等）。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-37">✅ 基本用法</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (navigator.<span class="hljs-property">share</span>) {
  navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">share</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">title</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'分享标题'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">text</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'分享的描述文字'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'https://example.com'</span>
  })
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'分享成功'</span>);
  })
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">error</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (error.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'用户取消了分享'</span>);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'分享失败:'</span>, error);
    }
  });
} <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 回退方案：显示自定义分享按钮或提示</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">alert</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'您的浏览器不支持 Web Share API，请手动复制链接'</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <strong>必须在用户手势触发的上下文中调用</strong>（如点击事件），否则会抛出安全错误。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-38">🔐 安全与限制</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>仅限安全上下文</strong>：必须在&nbsp;<code>HTTPS</code>（或&nbsp;<code>localhost</code>）下使用。</li>
<li><strong>用户手势要求</strong>：只能在&nbsp;<code>click</code>、<code>touchend</code>&nbsp;等用户操作回调中调用。</li>
<li><strong>字段非全部必需</strong>：但至少要提供&nbsp;<code>title</code>、<code>text</code>、<code>url</code>&nbsp;中的一个（推荐提供&nbsp;<code>url</code>）。</li>
<li><strong>无法控制目标应用</strong>：分享目标由操作系统决定，开发者无法指定（如“只分享到微信”）。</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-39">📱 支持情况（截至 2025 年）</h3>



































<table><thead><tr><th>平台</th><th>浏览器</th><th>支持情况</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Android</td><td>Chrome 61+</td><td>✅ 完整支持</td></tr><tr><td>iOS</td><td>Safari 12.2+</td><td>✅（需 iOS 12.2+）</td></tr><tr><td>Windows</td><td>Chrome 76+ / Edge 79+</td><td>✅（调用系统分享面板）</td></tr><tr><td>macOS</td><td>Safari 13+ / Chrome</td><td>✅（部分版本）</td></tr><tr><td>Linux</td><td>部分浏览器</td><td>⚠️ 有限支持</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>可通过 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">caniuse.com/web-share</a> 查看最新兼容性。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-40">🧩 高级用法：分享文件（Web Share API Level 2）</h3>
<p>现代浏览器（Chrome 89+ 等）支持分享<strong>文件</strong>（如图片、PDF）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (navigator.<span class="hljs-property">canShare</span> &amp;&amp; navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">canShare</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">files</span>: [file] })) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">share</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">title</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'图片分享'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">files</span>: [file] <span class="hljs-comment">// File 对象数组</span>
  });
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：文件必须来自用户选择（如 <code>&lt;input type="file"&gt;</code>）或由网页生成，不能是任意网络文件。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-41">🔄 回退方案（Fallback）</h3>
<p>当不支持 Web Share 时，可提供复制链接或自定义分享按钮：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fallbackShare</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> input = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>);
  input.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = url;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(input);
  input.<span class="hljs-title function_">select</span>();
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">execCommand</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'copy'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeChild</span>(input);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">alert</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'链接已复制到剪贴板'</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-42">📦 在框架中使用（React 示例）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">ShareButton</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ url, title, text }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleShare</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (navigator.<span class="hljs-property">share</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">share</span>({ url, title, text });
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'分享被取消或失败'</span>, err);
      }
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">fallbackShare</span>(url);
    }
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{handleShare}</span>&gt;</span>
      分享
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-43">🚀 优势</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>原生体验</strong>：使用系统分享面板，用户熟悉且支持所有已安装应用。</li>
<li><strong>无需第三方 SDK</strong>：避免集成微信、微博等 SDK 的复杂性。</li>
<li><strong>隐私友好</strong>：不收集用户分享行为数据（除非你自己上报）。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-44">📌 小贴士</h3>
<ul>
<li>测试时可在 Chrome DevTools 的&nbsp;<strong>Device Mode（设备模拟）</strong> &nbsp;中查看分享弹窗。</li>
<li>在 PWA 中使用效果最佳，可实现“类原生”分享体验。</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-45">5. Wake Lock</h2>
<p><code>Wake Lock API</code> 是一个现代 Web API，允许网页<strong>防止设备进入休眠状态</strong>（如屏幕变暗、锁屏），常用于需要长时间保持活跃的场景，例如：</p>
<ul>
<li>视频播放器（避免播放时屏幕关闭）</li>
<li>导航应用（持续显示路线）</li>
<li>扫码/AR 应用（保持摄像头活跃）</li>
<li>阅读器/电子书（长时间阅读不锁屏）</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-46">🔒 两种锁类型（目前主要支持&nbsp;<code>screen</code>）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 1. Screen Wake Lock（屏幕唤醒锁） ← 当前唯一广泛支持的类型</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. System Wake Lock（系统唤醒锁） ← 尚未标准化，基本不可用</span>
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>目前 <strong>只有 <code>screen</code> 类型</strong> 在主流浏览器中可用。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-47">✅ 基本用法（Screen Wake Lock）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> wakeLock = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">requestWakeLock</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 请求屏幕唤醒锁</span>
    wakeLock = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-property">wakeLock</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">request</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'screen'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Wake Lock 已激活'</span>);

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听释放事件（如页面隐藏、用户锁屏）</span>
    wakeLock.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'release'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Wake Lock 已释放'</span>);
    });

  } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Wake Lock 请求失败:'</span>, err);
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 在用户交互后调用（如点击按钮）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getElementById</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keepAwakeBtn'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, requestWakeLock);
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <strong>必须由用户手势触发</strong>（如 <code>click</code>），不能在页面加载时自动请求。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-48">🛑 释放锁（可选，通常自动释放）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (wakeLock) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> wakeLock.<span class="hljs-title function_">release</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 显式释放</span>
  wakeLock = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>锁会在以下情况<strong>自动释放</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>页面进入后台（<code>visibilitychange</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>hidden</code>）</li>
<li>浏览器标签页关闭</li>
<li>用户手动锁屏</li>
<li>页面失去焦点（部分浏览器）</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-49">🌐 浏览器兼容性（截至 2025 年）</h3>

























<table><thead><tr><th>浏览器</th><th>支持情况</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Chrome</td><td>✅ 84+（Android &amp; Desktop）</td></tr><tr><td>Edge</td><td>✅ 84+</td></tr><tr><td>Safari</td><td>❌ 不支持（iOS/macOS 均未实现）</td></tr><tr><td>Firefox</td><td>❌ 默认禁用（需手动开启&nbsp;<code>dom.wakelock.enabled</code>）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>移动端 Chrome（Android）支持最好</strong>，iOS Safari <strong>完全不支持</strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>可通过 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">caniuse.com/wake-lock</a> 查看最新状态。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-50">🛡️ 安全与权限要求</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>必须在 HTTPS 下使用</strong>（localhost 除外）</li>
<li><strong>必须由用户手势触发</strong>（如点击、触摸）</li>
<li><strong>仅在页面可见时有效</strong>（页面切到后台会自动释放）</li>
<li><strong>不会绕过系统锁屏密码</strong>，仅防止屏幕变暗/休眠</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-51">💡 实际应用场景示例</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-52">场景：视频播放时不锁屏</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> video = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">querySelector</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'video'</span>);

video.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'play'</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-string">'wakeLock'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> navigator) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      wakeLock = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-property">wakeLock</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">request</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'screen'</span>);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'无法保持屏幕常亮:'</span>, err);
    }
  }
});

video.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'pause'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (wakeLock) wakeLock.<span class="hljs-title function_">release</span>();
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-53">场景：结合 Page Visibility 自动管理</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span> &amp;&amp; wakeLock) {
    wakeLock.<span class="hljs-title function_">release</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 页面隐藏时主动释放</span>
  }
});
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-54">🔄 降级方案（Fallback）</h3>
<p>在不支持 Wake Lock 的环境（如 iOS）：</p>
<ul>
<li>提示用户“请手动关闭自动锁屏”</li>
<li>使用全屏 API（<code>requestFullscreen()</code>）有时可延长屏幕活跃时间（非可靠）</li>
<li>对于视频，可尝试使用&nbsp;<code>&lt;video playsinline webkit-playsinline&gt;</code>&nbsp;等属性优化体验</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-55">📌 注意事项</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>不要滥用</strong>：长时间保持唤醒会显著增加耗电。</li>
<li><strong>始终提供关闭选项</strong>：让用户能手动禁用“保持唤醒”。</li>
<li><strong>测试真实设备</strong>：模拟器行为可能与真机不同。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-56">🔍 检测是否支持</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-string">'wakeLock'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> navigator) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 支持 Wake Lock API</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-57">6. Broadcast Channel</h2>
<p><code>BroadcastChannel</code> 是一个现代 Web API，允许<strong>同源（same-origin）的不同浏览器上下文</strong>（如多个标签页、iframe、Web Worker）之间进行<strong>简单、高效的跨文档通信</strong>。
它类似于“发布-订阅”模式：一个上下文发送消息，所有监听同一频道的其他上下文都能收到。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-58">🧩 基本用法</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-59">1. 创建频道并监听消息</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 所有页面/worker 使用相同的频道名</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> channel = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BroadcastChannel</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'my-app-channel'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 监听来自其他上下文的消息</span>
channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'message'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'收到消息:'</span>, event.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>);
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 或使用 onmessage</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// channel.onmessage = (event) =&gt; { ... };</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-60">2. 发送消息</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 任意同源页面或 worker 中</span>
channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'USER_LOGIN'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">userId</span>: <span class="hljs-number">123</span> });
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-61">3. 关闭频道（可选，推荐在页面卸载时调用）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'beforeunload'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 释放资源</span>
});
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ <strong>自动广播</strong>：消息会发送给<strong>所有</strong>监听 <code>'my-app-channel'</code> 的同源上下文（包括发送者自己，除非你过滤）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-62">🔐 安全限制</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>同源策略</strong>：只有协议 + 域名 + 端口完全相同的页面才能通信。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>https://example.com/page1</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>https://example.com/page2</code>&nbsp;✅</li>
<li><code>https://example.com</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>https://sub.example.com</code>&nbsp;❌</li>
<li><code>http://localhost:3000</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>http://localhost:8080</code>&nbsp;❌</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不支持跨域</strong>：不能用于跨域 iframe 通信（此时应考虑 <code>postMessage</code> + <code>origin</code> 验证）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-63">✅ 典型应用场景</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-64">1.&nbsp;<strong>用户登录/登出同步</strong></h4>
<p>当用户在一个标签页登录，其他标签页自动更新状态：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 登录页</span>
channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'AUTH_CHANGED'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">user</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'Alice'</span> } });

<span class="hljs-comment">// 其他页面</span>
channel.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'AUTH_CHANGED'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">updateUI</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 显示用户信息</span>
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">logoutAllTabs</span>(); <span class="hljs-comment">// 用户登出</span>
    }
  }
};
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-65">2.&nbsp;<strong>多标签页状态同步</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>购物车变更</li>
<li>主题切换（深色/浅色模式）</li>
<li>语言切换</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-66">3.&nbsp;<strong>通知其他标签页刷新数据</strong></h4>
<p>例如后台管理页更新后，通知前台页面重新拉取配置。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-67">4.&nbsp;<strong>与 Web Worker 通信</strong></h4>
<p>主线程和多个 worker 可通过 BroadcastChannel 广播消息。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-68">🌐 浏览器兼容性（截至 2025 年）</h3>





























<table><thead><tr><th>浏览器</th><th>支持情况</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Chrome</td><td>✅ 54+</td></tr><tr><td>Edge</td><td>✅ 79+</td></tr><tr><td>Firefox</td><td>✅ 38+</td></tr><tr><td>Safari</td><td>✅ 15.4+（iOS 15.4+ / macOS Monterey+）</td></tr><tr><td>iOS WebView</td><td>✅ 15.4+</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <strong>Safari 在 15.4 之前完全不支持</strong>，如需兼容旧版 iOS，需使用 <code>localStorage</code> + <code>storage</code> 事件作为 fallback。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-69">🔄 降级方案（Fallback for older browsers）</h3>
<p>利用 <code>localStorage</code> 的 <code>storage</code> 事件实现类似广播：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 发送消息（fallback）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">broadcastFallback</span>(<span class="hljs-params">message</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'broadcast-msg'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({
    ...message,
    <span class="hljs-attr">timestamp</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>()
  }));
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 接收消息（其他标签页会触发 storage 事件）</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'storage'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">key</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'broadcast-msg'</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> message = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(e.<span class="hljs-property">newValue</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Fallback 收到:'</span>, message);
  }
});
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>缺点：只能传递字符串，且 <code>storage</code> 事件<strong>不会在当前标签页触发</strong>（正好避免自己收到自己发的消息）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-70">🆚 与其他通信方式对比</h3>








































<table><thead><tr><th>方式</th><th>适用场景</th><th>跨域</th><th>多标签</th><th>Worker</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>BroadcastChannel</code></td><td>同源多上下文广播</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><code>window.postMessage</code></td><td>精确点对点通信</td><td>✅（需验证 origin）</td><td>✅（需持有 window 引用）</td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><code>SharedWorker</code></td><td>多页面共享逻辑</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td><td>✅（作为中介）</td></tr><tr><td><code>localStorage + storage</code></td><td>简单广播（旧浏览器）</td><td>❌</td><td>✅</td><td>❌</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-71">💡 小技巧</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>避免无限循环</strong>：如果多个页面都响应消息并再次广播，可能形成循环。建议使用&nbsp;<code>type</code>&nbsp;字段区分消息来源或添加防重机制。</li>
<li><strong>结构化克隆</strong>：<code>postMessage</code>&nbsp;支持传输&nbsp;<code>ArrayBuffer</code>、<code>Blob</code>、<code>Map</code>&nbsp;等（遵循<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">结构化克隆算法</a>），不只是 JSON。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-72">📦 在框架中使用（React 示例）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-jsx" lang="jsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useBroadcastChannel</span>(<span class="hljs-params">channelName, onMessage</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> channel = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BroadcastChannel</span>(channelName);
    channel.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = onMessage;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>();
    };
  }, [channelName, onMessage]);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useBroadcastChannel</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'theme-channel'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'THEME_CHANGE'</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-property">className</span> = e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">theme</span>;
    }
  });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">changeTheme</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">theme</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BroadcastChannel</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'theme-channel'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'THEME_CHANGE'</span>,
      theme
    });
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{()</span> =&gt;</span> changeTheme('dark')}&gt;切换深色<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong><code>BroadcastChannel和 Vuex / Redux</code></strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-73">🔍 核心区别</h4>








































<table><thead><tr><th>特性</th><th><code>BroadcastChannel</code></th><th>Vuex / Redux / Zustand 等</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>作用范围</strong></td><td><strong>跨浏览器上下文</strong>（多个标签页、iframe、Web Worker）</td><td><strong>单个页面/应用内部</strong>（组件之间）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>通信方式</strong></td><td>跨文档广播（类似“全局事件总线”）</td><td>单向数据流 + 响应式状态管理</td></tr><tr><td><strong>数据存储</strong></td><td>❌ 不存储状态，只传递消息</td><td>✅ 集中式存储状态（store）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>响应式更新</strong></td><td>❌ 需手动监听消息并更新 UI</td><td>✅ 状态变化自动触发组件重渲染</td></tr><tr><td><strong>同源限制</strong></td><td>✅ 仅限同源页面</td><td>无（仅限当前页面）</td></tr><tr><td><strong>典型用途</strong></td><td>多标签页登录同步、跨 Worker 通信</td><td>组件间状态共享、复杂状态逻辑管理</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-74">🧩 举个例子说明差异</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-75">场景：用户登录后，所有打开的标签页都要显示用户名</h5>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>用 <code>BroadcastChannel</code></strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>标签页 A 登录 → 通过&nbsp;<code>channel.postMessage({ type: 'LOGIN', user })</code>&nbsp;广播。</li>
<li>标签页 B、C（即使没用 Vue/React）监听到消息 →&nbsp;<strong>各自更新自己的 UI</strong>。</li>
<li>每个页面<strong>独立维护自己的状态</strong>，只是通过消息“同步”了登录事件。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>用 Vuex</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>只在<strong>当前标签页内</strong>，多个 Vue 组件共享&nbsp;<code>store.state.user</code>。</li>
<li>标签页 A 的 Vuex&nbsp;<strong>无法直接影响</strong>标签页 B 的 Vuex。</li>
<li>如果你打开两个标签页，它们有<strong>两个完全独立的 Vuex 实例</strong>。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ 所以：<strong>Vuex 管“页面内”，BroadcastChannel 管“页面间”</strong> 。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-76">🤝 它们可以结合使用！</h4>
<p>实际项目中，<strong>两者常配合使用</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 Vuex 的 action 中监听 BroadcastChannel</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> channel = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">BroadcastChannel</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'auth-channel'</span>);

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> store = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Vuex</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Store</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">user</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> },
  <span class="hljs-attr">mutations</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">SET_USER</span>(<span class="hljs-params">state, user</span>) {
      state.<span class="hljs-property">user</span> = user;
    }
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">actions</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">login</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ commit }, user</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'SET_USER'</span>, user);
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 登录后广播给其他标签页</span>
      channel.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'LOGIN'</span>, user });
    }
  }
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 监听其他标签页的登录/登出</span>
channel.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'LOGIN'</span>) {
    store.<span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'SET_USER'</span>, e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">user</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 更新当前页状态</span>
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'LOGOUT'</span>) {
    store.<span class="hljs-title function_">commit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'SET_USER'</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>);
  }
};
</code></pre>
<p>这样：</p>
<ul>
<li>页面内：Vuex 管理状态，组件自动响应。</li>
<li>页面间：BroadcastChannel 同步关键事件。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-77">❓那有没有“跨标签页的 Vuex”？</h4>
<p>有！社区有一些库尝试结合两者，例如：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><code>vuex-shared-mutations</code></a>：通过&nbsp;<code>localStorage</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>BroadcastChannel</code>&nbsp;同步 Vuex 的 mutations。</li>
<li>自定义方案：监听&nbsp;<code>storage</code>&nbsp;事件或&nbsp;<code>BroadcastChannel</code>，触发本地 store 更新。</li>
</ul>
<p>但核心思想不变：<strong>跨标签页通信靠 BroadcastChannel（或 storage），状态管理靠 Vuex</strong>。</p>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-78">✅ 总结</h4>





















<table><thead><tr><th>你想做……</th><th>该用……</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>组件之间共享状态、触发更新</td><td><strong>Vuex / Redux / Context / Zustand</strong></td></tr><tr><td>多个浏览器标签页同步登录状态</td><td><strong>BroadcastChannel</strong>（或&nbsp;<code>localStorage</code>&nbsp;+&nbsp;<code>storage</code>&nbsp;事件）</td></tr><tr><td>让 Vuex 状态在多标签页同步</td><td><strong>BroadcastChannel + Vuex 结合</strong></td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2 data-id="heading-79">7. PerformanceObserver</h2>
<p><code>PerformanceObserver</code> 是一个强大的 Web API，用于<strong>异步监听性能相关的事件和指标</strong>，而无需轮询 <code>performance.getEntries()</code>。它是现代 Web 性能监控（如 Core Web Vitals）的核心工具。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-80">🎯 核心作用</h3>
<p>监听浏览器自动记录的 <strong>Performance Timeline（性能时间线）</strong> 中的新条目，例如：</p>
<ul>
<li>资源加载（<code>resource</code>）</li>
<li>导航 timing（<code>navigation</code>）</li>
<li>长任务（<code>longtask</code>）</li>
<li>元素曝光（<code>element</code>，实验性）</li>
<li><strong>最重要：</strong> &nbsp;<strong>CLS、LCP、FCP、INP 等 Web Vitals 指标</strong></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-81">🧩 基本用法</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">entryType</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">startTime</span>, entry.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span>);
  }
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 开始监听特定类型的性能条目</span>
observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">entryTypes</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'navigation'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'paint'</span>] });
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ 必须指定 <code>entryTypes</code>（或 <code>type</code>），否则不会触发回调。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-82">🔍 常见&nbsp;<code>entryTypes</code>&nbsp;及用途</h3>













































<table><thead><tr><th><code>entryType</code></th><th>说明</th><th>典型用途</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>'navigation'</code></td><td>页面导航性能（如 DNS、TCP、DOMContentLoaded）</td><td>分析首屏加载瓶颈</td></tr><tr><td><code>'resource'</code></td><td>所有资源加载（JS、CSS、图片、XHR、fetch）</td><td>监控第三方资源、慢请求</td></tr><tr><td><code>'paint'</code></td><td>首次绘制（FP）、首次内容绘制（FCP）</td><td>衡量视觉加载速度</td></tr><tr><td><code>'longtask'</code></td><td>超过 50ms 的主线程任务</td><td>识别卡顿、影响交互响应的原因</td></tr><tr><td><code>'largest-contentful-paint'</code>&nbsp;(LCP)</td><td>最大内容元素渲染时间</td><td>核心 Web Vitals 指标</td></tr><tr><td><code>'layout-shift'</code>&nbsp;(CLS)</td><td>累积布局偏移</td><td>检测页面“抖动”</td></tr><tr><td><code>'first-input'</code>&nbsp;(FID) /&nbsp;<code>'event'</code>&nbsp;(INP)</td><td>首次输入延迟 / 交互到下次绘制</td><td>衡量交互响应性</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ <strong>LCP、CLS、INP 等现代指标必须通过 <code>PerformanceObserver</code> 获取</strong>，无法通过 <code>getEntries()</code> 静态读取。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-83">✅ 实战示例</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-84">1. 监听 LCP（最大内容绘制）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> lcpReported = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entryList</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lcpEntry = entryList.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">at</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 取最后一个（最准确）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!lcpReported) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'LCP:'</span>, lcpEntry.<span class="hljs-property">startTime</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 单位：毫秒</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 上报到分析平台</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">sendToAnalytics</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">metric</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'LCP'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: lcpEntry.<span class="hljs-property">startTime</span> });
    lcpReported = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
  }
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'largest-contentful-paint'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><code>buffered: true</code> 表示获取<strong>已发生但未被观察到的历史条目</strong>（对 LCP/CLS 必须加！）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-85">2. 监听 CLS（累积布局偏移）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> clsValue = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">entryList</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> entryList.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!entry.<span class="hljs-property">hadRecentInput</span>) { <span class="hljs-comment">// 忽略用户交互后的偏移</span>
      clsValue += entry.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'当前 CLS:'</span>, clsValue);
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'layout-shift'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-86">3. 监控慢资源加载</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> resource <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resource.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">2000</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'慢资源:'</span>, resource.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>, resource.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'ms'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 上报性能问题</span>
    }
  }
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">entryTypes</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>] });
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-87">4. 捕获长任务（卡顿原因）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> task <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (task.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">100</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'长任务:'</span>, task.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'ms'</span>, task.<span class="hljs-property">attribution</span>);
    }
  }
}).<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">entryTypes</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'longtask'</span>] });
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>需要先注册长任务支持（部分浏览器需 polyfill）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>.<span class="hljs-property">supportedEntryTypes</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'longtask'</span>)) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 启用观察</span>
}
</code></pre>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-88">🌐 浏览器兼容性</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ Chrome / Edge：全面支持（包括 Web Vitals）</li>
<li>✅ Firefox：支持基础类型（<code>resource</code>,&nbsp;<code>navigation</code>），Web Vitals 支持较弱</li>
<li>✅ Safari 15+：支持 LCP、CLS、FCP 等核心指标</li>
<li>❌ IE：不支持</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>推荐使用 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Google 的 <code>web-vitals</code> 库</a> 跨浏览器采集 Core Web Vitals。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-89">📦 与&nbsp;<code>performance.getEntries()</code>&nbsp;对比</h3>




















<table><thead><tr><th>方式</th><th>优点</th><th>缺点</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>PerformanceObserver</code></td><td>异步、实时、支持 Web Vitals、不阻塞主线程</td><td>需要提前注册监听</td></tr><tr><td><code>performance.getEntries()</code></td><td>简单直接、可查询历史</td><td>无法获取动态指标（如 LCP 在发生时才能确定）、需轮询</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ <strong>现代性能监控应优先使用 <code>PerformanceObserver</code></strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-90">🚀 最佳实践</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>尽早注册</strong>：在&nbsp;<code>&lt;head&gt;</code>&nbsp;中或页面顶部初始化，避免漏掉早期指标。</li>
<li><strong>使用&nbsp;<code>buffered: true</code></strong>：确保捕获 FCP、LCP、CLS 等可能在监听前已发生的指标。</li>
<li><strong>避免内存泄漏</strong>：通常不需要&nbsp;<code>disconnect()</code>，因为性能条目是一次性的。</li>
<li><strong>结合 RUM（真实用户监控）</strong> ：将数据上报到分析平台（如 GA4、Sentry、自建服务）。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-91">🛠️ 工具推荐</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><code>web-vitals</code>&nbsp;npm 包</a>：Google 官方封装，一行代码获取 Web Vitals。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getLCP, getCLS, getFCP } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'web-vitals'</span>;
<span class="hljs-title function_">getLCP</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-property">log</span>);
</code></pre>
<p><strong>React（使用 Hook）</strong> 和 <strong>Vue 3（使用 Composition API）</strong></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-92">✅ 共同前提</h3>
<p>我们使用 Google 官方的 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><code>web-vitals</code></a> 库，它已封装好 <code>PerformanceObserver</code> 的兼容逻辑。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">npm install web-vitals
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-93">🟦 React 版本：<code>useWebVitals</code></h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// hooks/useWebVitals.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getCLS, getFCP, getLCP, getFID, getINP } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'web-vitals'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebVitalsMetric</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">delta</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">entries</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceEntry</span>[];
  <span class="hljs-attr">attribution</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebVitalsOptions</span> = {
  onReport?: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">metric: WebVitalsMetric</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>;
  reportAll?: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 是否上报所有指标（默认只上报一次）</span>
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebVitals</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">{
  onReport,
  reportAll = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
}: WebVitalsOptions = {}</span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 定义上报函数</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">report</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">metric: WebVitalsMetric</span>) =&gt; {
      onReport?.(metric);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (process.<span class="hljs-property">env</span>.<span class="hljs-property">NODE_ENV</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'development'</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Web Vitals:'</span>, metric);
      }
    };

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 启动监听（Web Vitals 内部使用 PerformanceObserver）</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getCLS</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getFCP</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getLCP</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getFID</span>(report); <span class="hljs-comment">// FID 只触发一次</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getINP</span>(report, reportAll); <span class="hljs-comment">// INP 替代 FID（未来标准）</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 注意：web-vitals 的指标是自动管理生命周期的，无需 cleanup</span>
  }, [onReport, reportAll]);
};
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-94">📌 使用示例</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// App.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useWebVitals } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./hooks/useWebVitals'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebVitals</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">onReport</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">metric</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 上报到分析平台（如 GA4、Sentry、自建 API）</span>
      <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/performance'</span>, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(metric),
        <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: { <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span> }
      });
    }
  });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span>你的应用<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ <strong>优点</strong>：自动处理浏览器兼容性、只上报有效指标、支持开发环境日志。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-95">🟩 Vue 3 版本：<code>useWebVitals</code></h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// composables/useWebVitals.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { onMounted } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getCLS, getFCP, getLCP, getFID, getINP } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'web-vitals'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">WebVitalsMetric</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">delta</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">entries</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceEntry</span>[];
  <span class="hljs-attr">attribution</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;;
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useWebVitals</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
  onReport?: (metric: WebVitalsMetric) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>,
  reportAll = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">report</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">metric: WebVitalsMetric</span>) =&gt; {
      onReport?.(metric);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>.<span class="hljs-property">meta</span>.<span class="hljs-property">env</span>.<span class="hljs-property">DEV</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Web Vitals:'</span>, metric);
      }
    };

    <span class="hljs-title function_">getCLS</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getFCP</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getLCP</span>(report, reportAll);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getFID</span>(report);
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getINP</span>(report, reportAll);
  });
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-96">📌 使用示例</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- App.vue --&gt;
&lt;script setup&gt;
import { useWebVitals } from './composables/useWebVitals';

useWebVitals((metric) =&gt; {
  fetch('/api/performance', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(metric),
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
  });
});
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div&gt;你的应用&lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-97">🧩 高级：监控慢资源加载（自定义 PerformanceObserver）</h3>
<p>如果你还想监控 JS/CSS/图片等资源加载性能，可以额外封装一个 Hook：</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-98">React:&nbsp;<code>useResourcePerformance</code></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// hooks/useResourcePerformance.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useResourcePerformance</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">onSlowResource: (entry: PerformanceResourceTiming) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>.<span class="hljs-property">supportedEntryTypes</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>)) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> observer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceResourceTiming</span>[]) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">2000</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-title function_">onSlowResource</span>(entry);
        }
      }
    });

    observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">entryTypes</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>] });

    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      observer.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>();
    };
  }, [onSlowResource]);
};
</code></pre>
<p>Vue 版本类似，用 <code>onMounted</code> + <code>onUnmounted</code> 管理生命周期。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-99">📊 上报建议</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>LCP、FCP、CLS</strong>：每个页面会话上报一次（<code>reportAll: false</code>）。</li>
<li><strong>INP/FID</strong>：用户每次交互可能触发，可采样上报。</li>
<li><strong>慢资源</strong>：可聚合后批量上报，避免频繁请求。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-100">🚀 部署提示</h3>
<ul>
<li>在&nbsp;<strong>生产环境</strong>&nbsp;使用，开发环境仅用于调试。</li>
<li>避免阻塞主渲染逻辑（<code>web-vitals</code>&nbsp;是异步非阻塞的）。</li>
<li>配合&nbsp;<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Google Analytics 4 的 Web Vitals 自动采集</a>&nbsp;更省事。</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-101">8. requestIdleCallback</h2>
<p><code>requestIdleCallback</code> 是一个浏览器提供的 API，用于<strong>在浏览器主线程空闲时执行低优先级任务</strong>，避免影响关键操作（如用户输入、动画、布局等），从而提升页面流畅性和响应性。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>💡 它是实现“<strong>协作式调度（Cooperative Scheduling）</strong> ”的关键工具，React 16+ 的 Fiber 架构就受其启发（尽管 React 最终未直接使用它）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-102">🧩 基本用法</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">doLowPriorityWork</span>(<span class="hljs-params">deadline</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// deadline.timeRemaining()：返回当前空闲时段还剩多少毫秒（通常 &lt; 50ms）</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// deadline.didTimeout：是否因超时而强制执行（配合 timeout 使用）</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">while</span> (deadline.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeRemaining</span>() &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span> || deadline.<span class="hljs-property">didTimeout</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title function_">hasWork</span>()) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">performUnitOfWork</span>();
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 没有更多工作，退出</span>
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果还有剩余任务，继续调度</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title function_">hasMoreWork</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">requestIdleCallback</span>(doLowPriorityWork);
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 启动任务</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">requestIdleCallback</span>(doLowPriorityWork, { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2000</span> });
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-103">⚙️ 参数说明</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-104">1. 回调函数参数：<code>deadline</code></h4>
<ul>
<li><code>deadline.timeRemaining()</code>：返回一个<strong>估算值</strong>（单位：毫秒），表示当前帧剩余的空闲时间（通常 ≤ 50ms）。</li>
<li><code>deadline.didTimeout</code>：如果设置了&nbsp;<code>timeout</code>&nbsp;且超时，则为&nbsp;<code>true</code>，此时应尽快完成任务。</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-105">2. 可选配置对象</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">{
  <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2000</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 最大等待时间（毫秒）。超时后即使没有空闲也会执行回调。</span>
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <strong><code>timeout</code> 会降低优先级优势</strong>，仅用于“最终必须执行”的兜底场景。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-106">✅ 典型应用场景</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-107">1.&nbsp;<strong>非关键数据预加载</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-title function_">requestIdleCallback</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 预加载下一页数据、图片、代码分割 chunk</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./NextPageComponent'</span>);
});
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-108">2.&nbsp;<strong>埋点/日志批量上报</strong></h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> logs = [];

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sendLogs</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (logs.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">sendBeacon</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/log'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(logs));
    logs = [];
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">addLog</span>(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) {
  logs.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(event);
  <span class="hljs-title function_">requestIdleCallback</span>(sendLogs, { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">5000</span> });
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-109">3.&nbsp;<strong>大型列表虚拟滚动的缓存计算</strong></h4>
<p>在用户停止滚动后，利用空闲时间预计算可视区域外的 item 尺寸。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-110">4.&nbsp;<strong>分析用户行为（非实时）</strong></h4>
<p>如统计停留时长、点击热力图聚合等。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-111">🌐 浏览器兼容性（截至 2025 年）</h3>





























<table><thead><tr><th>浏览器</th><th>支持情况</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Chrome</td><td>✅ 47+</td></tr><tr><td>Edge</td><td>✅ 79+</td></tr><tr><td>Firefox</td><td>❌&nbsp;<strong>不支持</strong>（已明确拒绝实现）</td></tr><tr><td>Safari</td><td>❌&nbsp;<strong>不支持</strong></td></tr><tr><td>iOS / Android WebView</td><td>❌ 基本不可用</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>🔥 <strong>现实：仅 Chrome/Edge 支持，Firefox 和 Safari 永远不会支持！</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>可通过 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=" title="" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">caniuse.com/requestidle…</a> 查看。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-112">🔄 降级方案（Polyfill / 替代方案）</h3>
<p>由于兼容性差，<strong>生产环境必须提供 fallback</strong>。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-113">方案 1：使用&nbsp;<code>setTimeout</code>&nbsp;模拟（简单但不精确）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> requestIdleCallback =
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">requestIdleCallback</span> ||
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">callback</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> start = <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">callback</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">didTimeout</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">timeRemaining</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">50</span> - (<span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() - start))
      });
    }, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>);
  };

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cancelIdleCallback =
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cancelIdleCallback</span> ||
  <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(id);
  };
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-114">方案 2：使用&nbsp;<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;+ 时间切片（更接近原生行为）</h4>
<p>适用于需要精细控制的任务调度（如 React Fiber 的思路）。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-115">方案 3：直接使用&nbsp;<code>setTimeout(fn, 0)</code>&nbsp;或&nbsp;<code>queueMicrotask</code></h4>
<p>适用于非关键但需异步执行的任务，但无法利用“空闲时间”。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-116">⚠️ 注意事项</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>不要执行高优先级任务</strong>：如用户输入响应、动画更新。</li>
<li><strong>避免长时间运行</strong>：即使&nbsp;<code>timeRemaining()</code>&nbsp;返回较大值，也应分片处理。</li>
<li><strong>不要依赖精确时间</strong>：<code>timeRemaining()</code>&nbsp;是估算值，可能突然变为 0。</li>
<li><strong>移动端效果有限</strong>：低端设备空闲时间极少，可能长期不触发。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-117">🆚 与&nbsp;<code>requestAnimationFrame</code>&nbsp;对比</h3>




















<table><thead><tr><th>API</th><th>时机</th><th>用途</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>requestAnimationFrame</code></td><td><strong>每一帧开始前</strong>（约 16ms 一次）</td><td>动画、视觉更新</td></tr><tr><td><code>requestIdleCallback</code></td><td><strong>每一帧结束后，若有空闲</strong></td><td>低优先级后台任务</td></tr></tbody></table>
<blockquote>
<p>✅ 两者互补：<code>rAF</code> 保证流畅动画，<code>rIC</code> 避免阻塞动画。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-118">📦 在现代框架中的使用</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>React</strong>：内部调度器受&nbsp;<code>rIC</code>&nbsp;启发，但使用自定义实现（因兼容性问题）。</li>
<li><strong>Vue / Svelte</strong>：一般不直接使用，但可用于自定义性能优化逻辑。</li>
<li><strong>推荐</strong>：在业务代码中谨慎使用，并做好降级。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
